Pr22.Util

Enum Variant.Types

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<Variant.Types>
      • Pr22.Util.Variant.Types
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<Variant.Types>
    Enclosing class:
    Variant

    public static enum Variant.Types
extends java.lang.Enum<Variant.Types>
    Available variant types. The values with AC tag are usable for creation only. For these types the value is automatically converted to the proper data type. The values with AS tag are usable for creation only. For these types the value is automatically converted to the proper string type.
